# SolarWinds

> SolarWinds makes observability, IT management and database software for IT operations teams, delivered as SaaS and as self-hosted products.

SolarWinds sells observability, network, systems, database, IT service management, incident response, remote support, security and file transfer software, delivered as SaaS and as self-hosted products. Most products offer a free trial, and a separate set of free tools is available. Product documentation is hosted on documentation.solarwinds.com.

## Platform and AI

- [SolarWinds Observability SaaS](https://www.solarwinds.com/solarwinds-observability): SaaS observability for metrics, traces, logs and user experience across cloud-native, on-premises and hybrid environments.
- [SolarWinds Observability Self-Hosted](https://www.solarwinds.com/hybrid-cloud-observability): Self-hosted observability for hybrid IT across networks, servers, applications and databases; distinct from the SaaS edition.
- [SolarWinds Avior](https://www.solarwinds.com/avior): Goal-oriented AI for IT operations that correlates alerts into incidents and gathers evidence across products within set guardrails.
- [SolarWinds AI](https://www.solarwinds.com/ai): Overview of SolarWinds AI features, including anomaly detection, root cause assist and dynamic alert thresholds.
- [Monitoring and Observability](https://www.solarwinds.com/observability): Overview of the SolarWinds Observability platform for monitoring applications, infrastructure, networks, logs and digital experience.
- [Enterprise Operations Console](https://www.solarwinds.com/enterprise-operations-console): Consolidates monitoring data from up to 100 distributed SolarWinds sites into one console.

## Network management

- [Network Performance Monitor](https://www.solarwinds.com/network-performance-monitor): Self-hosted monitoring of multi-vendor network device availability and performance, with auto-discovery and customizable dashboards.
- [Network Configuration Manager](https://www.solarwinds.com/network-configuration-manager): Automates network device configuration backup, change detection and compliance checks across multi-vendor environments.
- [NetFlow Traffic Analyzer](https://www.solarwinds.com/netflow-traffic-analyzer): Analyzes NetFlow, J-Flow, sFlow and IPFIX data to show bandwidth use by application.
- [IP Address Manager](https://www.solarwinds.com/ip-address-manager): Tracks IPv4 and IPv6 addresses and administers DHCP and DNS servers from one console.
- [Network Automation Manager](https://www.solarwinds.com/network-automation-manager): Combines network monitoring, traffic analysis and configuration management for large or complex on-premises, cloud and hybrid environments.
- [Network Topology Mapper](https://www.solarwinds.com/network-topology-mapper): Discovers network devices automatically and builds topology diagrams from scans.
- [User Device Tracker](https://www.solarwinds.com/user-device-tracker): Locates where users and devices connect to the network, searchable by IP, MAC address or hostname.
- [VoIP and Network Quality Manager](https://www.solarwinds.com/voip-network-quality-manager): Monitors VoIP call quality and WAN performance, including jitter, latency and packet loss.
- [Engineer's Toolset](https://www.solarwinds.com/engineers-toolset): Bundle of over 60 network discovery, diagnostic and monitoring utilities for network engineers.
- [Kiwi CatTools](https://www.solarwinds.com/kiwi-cattools): Schedules configuration backups and bulk changes for routers, switches and firewalls.

## Systems, applications, and logs

- [Server & Application Monitor](https://www.solarwinds.com/server-application-monitor): Monitors server and application health across hybrid and cloud environments using built-in monitoring templates.
- [Virtualization Manager](https://www.solarwinds.com/virtualization-manager): Monitors VMware, Hyper-V and Nutanix environments with capacity planning and performance troubleshooting.
- [Storage Resource Monitor](https://www.solarwinds.com/storage-resource-monitor): Monitors health, performance and capacity of multi-vendor SAN and NAS storage arrays.
- [Server Configuration Monitor](https://www.solarwinds.com/server-configuration-monitor): Tracks and alerts on configuration changes across servers, applications and databases.
- [Web Performance Monitor](https://www.solarwinds.com/web-performance-monitor): Monitors web application performance using synthetic transactions and multi-location testing.
- [Log Analyzer](https://www.solarwinds.com/log-analyzer): Collects, searches and correlates log and event data, including syslog, SNMP traps and Windows events.
- [Papertrail](https://www.solarwinds.com/papertrail): SaaS log management for troubleshooting infrastructure and applications, with real-time search and alerts; separate from Loggly.
- [Loggly](https://www.solarwinds.com/loggly): SaaS log management and analysis that visualizes data from many sources in one place; separate from Papertrail.
- [Pingdom](https://www.solarwinds.com/pingdom): SaaS uptime, website and performance monitoring that needs no installation; separate from self-hosted Web Performance Monitor.
- [Kiwi Syslog Server](https://www.solarwinds.com/kiwi-syslog-server): On-premises server for syslog messages, SNMP traps and Windows event logs; a separate free edition is listed under Free tools.
- [Kiwi Log Viewer](https://www.solarwinds.com/kiwi-log-viewer): Displays and searches text-based log files in a tabular format with real-time updates.

## Database

- [Database Performance Analyzer](https://www.solarwinds.com/database-performance-analyzer): Agentless monitoring and tuning of multiple database platforms, including SQL Server, Oracle and MySQL.
- [SolarWinds SQL Sentry](https://www.solarwinds.com/sql-sentry): Performance monitoring and tuning for Microsoft SQL Server only, including Azure SQL Database.
- [Database Observability](https://www.solarwinds.com/database): Overview of SolarWinds database monitoring, troubleshooting and optimization across on-premises and cloud environments.
- [DBA Toolkit](https://www.solarwinds.com/database/dba-toolkit): Hub of free tools, checklists, guides and webcasts for database administrators.

## IT service management and remote support

- [Service Desk](https://www.solarwinds.com/service-desk): SaaS IT service management with incident management, service catalog and integrated IT asset management.
- [Web Help Desk](https://www.solarwinds.com/web-help-desk): Self-hosted help desk software for tickets, assets and SLAs; the self-hosted alternative to Service Desk.
- [SolarWinds Incident Response](https://www.solarwinds.com/it-incident-response-software): SaaS incident response with alert correlation, on-call scheduling and incident collaboration.
- [ITSM Solutions](https://www.solarwinds.com/itsm): Overview of SolarWinds IT service management, including incident handling, asset management and AI-powered automation.
- [Dameware Remote Everywhere](https://www.solarwinds.com/dameware-remote-everywhere): Cloud-based SaaS remote support tool with mobile device control, ticketing and reporting.
- [Dameware Remote Support](https://www.solarwinds.com/remote-support-software): Self-hosted remote control and systems administration tools with multi-factor authentication and Web Help Desk integration.
- [Dameware Mini Remote Control](https://www.solarwinds.com/dameware-mini-remote-control): Self-hosted remote desktop tool for IT staff to connect to Windows, Mac and Linux machines.
- [Dameware](https://www.solarwinds.com/dameware): Overview of the Dameware family, with SaaS and on-premises remote access and support products.

## Security, compliance, and file transfer

- [Security Event Manager](https://www.solarwinds.com/security-event-manager): SIEM software that centralizes log data, detects threats and automates compliance reporting.
- [Access Rights Manager](https://www.solarwinds.com/access-rights-manager): Audits and manages user access rights across Active Directory, file servers, SharePoint and Exchange.
- [Patch Manager](https://www.solarwinds.com/patch-manager): Automates patching of Microsoft and third-party applications, including scheduling, deployment and reporting.
- [Serv-U FTP Server](https://www.solarwinds.com/ftp-server-software): File transfer server for FTP, FTPS and SFTP with web and mobile access; the base Serv-U edition.
- [Serv-U Managed File Transfer Server](https://www.solarwinds.com/serv-u-managed-file-transfer-server): Extends Serv-U FTP Server with ad-hoc file sharing, high availability, and Active Directory and LDAP authentication.
- [Serv-U Gateway](https://www.solarwinds.com/gateway): Optional add-on for Serv-U FTP and MFT servers that keeps data out of the DMZ; not sold standalone.
- [Serv-U](https://www.solarwinds.com/serv-u): Overview of the Serv-U FTP Server, Managed File Transfer Server and Gateway products for Windows and Linux.

## Free tools

- [Free tools overview](https://www.solarwinds.com/free-tools): Index of free network, systems, security and database tools, grouped by category.
- [Kiwi Syslog Server Free Edition](https://www.solarwinds.com/free-tools/kiwi-free-syslog-server): Free edition for collecting, viewing and archiving syslog messages and SNMP traps with basic alerts.
- [Solar-PuTTY](https://www.solarwinds.com/free-tools/solar-putty): Free Windows tool for managing SSH and other remote sessions to servers and network devices.
- [TFTP Server](https://www.solarwinds.com/free-tools/free-tftp-server): Free TFTP server for moving files to and from routers, switches and other network devices.
- [SFTP/SCP Server](https://www.solarwinds.com/free-tools/free-sftp-server): Free SFTP and SCP server for moving files to and from network devices securely.
- [FTP Voyager](https://www.solarwinds.com/free-tools/ftp-voyager): Free file transfer client for exchanging and synchronizing files over FTP, FTPS and SFTP.
- [Advanced Subnet Calculator](https://www.solarwinds.com/free-tools/advanced-subnet-calculator): Free online subnet calculator that creates lists of addresses for subnets.
- [Traceroute NG](https://www.solarwinds.com/free-tools/traceroute-ng): Free traceroute tool with TCP probing to find packet loss and latency along network paths.
- [Flow Tool Bundle](https://www.solarwinds.com/free-tools/flow-tool-bundle): Free tools to distribute, test and configure flow traffic.
- [NetFlow Configurator](https://www.solarwinds.com/free-tools/netflow-configurator): Free tool that remotely configures NetFlow via SNMP on supported Cisco devices.
- [GNS3 Network Emulator](https://www.solarwinds.com/free-tools/gns3-network-emulator): Free virtual environment to build, design and test networks and validate GNS3 virtual network performance.
- [Event Log Forwarder for Windows](https://www.solarwinds.com/free-tools/event-log-forwarder-for-windows): Free tool that forwards Windows event logs to a syslog server.
- [Admin Bundle for Active Directory](https://www.solarwinds.com/free-tools/active-directory-admin-tools-bundle): Free set of three tools to add and remove Active Directory users and computers in bulk.
- [Access Rights Auditor](https://www.solarwinds.com/free-tools/access-rights-auditor): Free tool that scans Active Directory and file system permissions to show possible risk areas.
- [Permissions Analyzer for Active Directory](https://www.solarwinds.com/free-tools/permissions-analyzer-for-active-directory): Free tool that shows NTFS user, group and permission details in Active Directory environments.
- [DBA xPress](https://www.solarwinds.com/free-tools/dba-xpress): Free tools for managing and comparing Microsoft SQL Server databases.
- [Plan Explorer](https://www.solarwinds.com/free-tools/plan-explorer): Free SQL Server query analysis and index optimization tool that visualizes execution plans.

## Buying and evaluating

- [Products and free trials](https://www.solarwinds.com/products): Catalog of SolarWinds products by category with links to trials, overviews and quotes.
- [Pricing](https://www.solarwinds.com/pricing): Pricing information by product category and deployment type, SaaS or self-hosted.
- [Interactive demos](https://www.solarwinds.com/interactive-demos): Self-guided product tours for selected SolarWinds products, including Avior and Observability.
- [Contact SolarWinds](https://www.solarwinds.com/company/contact-us): Contact options for sales, support and product questions.
- [Partners](https://www.solarwinds.com/partners): Partner program overview covering resellers, distributors, system integrators, service providers and alliances.
- [Partner locator](https://www.solarwinds.com/partners/locator): Directory for finding SolarWinds partners that provide technical expertise, services and solutions.
- [Public sector](https://www.solarwinds.com/public-sector/it-management-solutions-for-government): Overview of SolarWinds IT management products for government and public sector organizations.

## Documentation and community

- [SolarWinds documentation](https://documentation.solarwinds.com/): Product documentation home page for SolarWinds products, hosted on a separate site.
- [SolarWinds Success Center](https://support.solarwinds.com/): Customer and product support site for SolarWinds software, hosted separately from the main website.
- [THWACK community](https://thwack.solarwinds.com/): SolarWinds user community forums for questions, best practices and product feedback.

## Optional

- [Company](https://www.solarwinds.com/company): Corporate overview of SolarWinds and its observability, incident response, database, ITSM and tools portfolio.
- [Security resources](https://www.solarwinds.com/trust-center): Security and privacy resources, policies and procedures published by SolarWinds.
- [Solutions](https://www.solarwinds.com/solutions): Index of solution pages by use case and industry, such as DevOps, cloud migration and education.
- [Orion Platform and SolarWinds Platform](https://www.solarwinds.com/orion-platform): FAQ on how the self-hosted SolarWinds Platform relates to the former Orion Platform.
- [SolarWinds Platform what's new](https://www.solarwinds.com/solarwinds-platform/whats-new): Latest SolarWinds Platform features, including AI agents and automations.
- [Resource Center](https://www.solarwinds.com/resources): Library of SolarWinds datasheets, guides and other resources.
- [Knowledge Hub](https://www.solarwinds.com/knowledge-hub): Insights, tutorials and best practices on monitoring and IT management.
- [SolarWinds Blog](https://www.solarwinds.com/blog): Articles on monitoring and observability, DevOps, AI and cybersecurity.
- [ITSM best practices](https://www.solarwinds.com/itsm-best-practices): Guide to ITSM best practices and service management maturity across incidents, changes, assets and SLAs.
- [SRE best practices](https://www.solarwinds.com/sre-best-practices): Guide to site reliability engineering practices for system reliability and performance.
- [DevOps best practices](https://www.solarwinds.com/devops-best-practices): Guide to DevOps practices such as automated testing, continuous integration and infrastructure as code.
- [Full-stack observability best practices](https://www.solarwinds.com/full-stack-observability): Guide to full-stack observability practices, including unified telemetry and data correlation.
- [Events](https://www.solarwinds.com/events): Catalog of upcoming SolarWinds events and virtual or on-demand webinars, including channel, government and MSP sessions.
- [Legal documents](https://www.solarwinds.com/legal/legal-documents): SolarWinds privacy policy, end user license agreement, software services agreements, terms of use and trademarks.
- [Secure by Design resources](https://www.solarwinds.com/secure-by-design-resources): Blogs, videos, news articles and other resources about the SolarWinds Secure by Design program.

AI is used for insight and low-risk intelligence. Start where AI can make an immediate difference—surface what matters, reveal patterns, and help teams understand their environment.

  • Map the interdependencies of your business-critical applications and infrastructure automatically and dynamically.
  • Cut through alert noise with event correlation, anomaly detection, and cross-environment context.

Explore Avior

AI is incorporated into everyday workflows and used broadly across teams. Embed AI into the way your teams investigate, decide, and respond—with people still directing the work.

  • Ask complex questions with a simple prompt and get grounded answers across your entire IT environment.
  • Pinpoint root cause, understand impact, and get recommended next steps with the evidence to act confidently.
  • Generate workflows, runbooks, and knowledge articles—or guide remediation with human control at every step.
Explore Avior

AI is trusted to coordinate work and take bounded action across systems. You set the goals and guardrails; Avior carries out more of the work while you and your team govern the outcome.

  • Set persistent goals that AI works toward continuously over time with human-in-the-loop workflows, or with the agent enabled to take specific actions under editable guardrails.
  • Avior can take action to help you reduce alert noise, close compliance gaps, automate backups, remediate config drift, and overall strengthen your operational resilience while freeing up your time.
